title: Return empty ready result when no work is eligible
description: Make task ready report an empty successful result instead of an error when no tasks are eligible, update text and JSON output semantics, add tests, and verify with ./scripts/check.sh.

comments.author: Jim
comments.message: Implementing no-ready-work as an explicit empty-result path via a provider sentinel error, so task ready can return success for empty queues while preserving real backend failures.

comments.author: Jim
comments.message: Changed task ready so empty queues return successful empty output (text: message, JSON: null or []), preserved real backend errors, verified with ./scripts/check.sh, and reinstalled the local binary.
